ns2:course.label: National Security Policy
ns2:course.description: Examines principal theories of international security and evaluates their capacity to explain the security behavior of states and other key international actors. Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
